film18b: Dashboards everywhere. The production wall runs twenty-four seven: your week, your month, your year, picked up for production, on the screen in the branch and on your phone. Nobody here waits for a month-end report to know where they stand.
film20b: And none of this is a mock-up. These are the screens. The client's draft on fact find three sixty. Your manager's sign-off. The client's approval, from their own inbox, with their rating of you. The reminders the system sends when a fact find is started and never sent, or never closed. The Log Book in your hand, and the transmittal it builds. The branch app, every tool behind one sign-in. Built here, in Chaguanas, for this branch.
film25b: And after the sale, the system keeps serving. The policy is delivered and signed for on the Delivery Book, and the client gets an e-mail the same day, with five stars to rate you. Your clients' premiums are watched for you: at forty-five, sixty, seventy-five and ninety days a letter goes, checked by a person, sent at ten. A review every six months and every birthday month. A question answered inside the turnaround. Happy clients rate their agents, and the branch sees it.
